description: ASEP’s 2023 electricity-generation dataset reports energy produced by Panama’s generating plants in megawatt-hours. The national open-data portal lists CSV, XLSX and PDF representations. The provider is Autoridad Nacional de los Servicios Públicos. Coverage: Coverage is Panama and reporting year 2023. The record was published and updated in April 2024 and labels publication frequency as half-yearly. Access: The official dataset metadata and format links were read. No data payload was obtained. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The page does not establish the file’s row granularity or a standard open licence. Reporting frequency is not necessarily the time step inside the files. For simulation it supplies a dated national generation total or plant-series source once the table schema is checked. Related resources: This dated statistical product is associated with ASEP’s broader electricity-water collection, separately reviewed in P04177.
